TaskDescription: CopyDraw: the patient copies traces shown on a screen with a stylus on a Wacom tablet (Castano-Candamil et al. 2019); self-paced readiness confirmation (marker 50), then copy-drawing of a trace (markers 10-21 start, 110-121 end, ~9 s). Blocks were recorded with DBS OFF, with continuous open-loop DBS ON, or (day 4) with closed-loop adaptive DBS.
Description: Auxiliary analog inputs recorded by the Neuro Omega at their native 2750.0 Hz during the same recording as sub-P001_ses-day2_task-copydraw_acq-stimoff_run-02_ieeg (Neuro Omega clock start 1954.745818 s vs 1954.745864 s for the 22 kHz channels).
